posts.title: Would you want a clone?
posts.description: If we had access to technology that could made a perfect clone of you. An exact replica of you. Would you take it? I asked dozens of people in my life this question - family, friends, coworkers. The response I received was an unanimous “no”. Not a single person out of the dozens I asked would want a clone.
